description: Search companies by industry (NACE code), country, region and size in official European business registers: France (Sirene), Norway (Brønnøysund), Finland (PRH/YTJ). Give one NACE code, Rev. 2 or Rev. 2.1 (class 62.01, group 62.0 or division 62): it is translated with the official correspondence tables into each registry's classification (NAF, SN2025, TOL), and only companies whose main activity matches come back, up to 25, with registry ID (SIREN / org.nr / Y-tunnus), status, both NACE codes, local code, size band, address, licence and attribution. No sole traders. 0.01 USDC per call, charged only if a company is found.

nace.description: NACE code, Rev. 2 or 2.1: class (62.01), group (62.0) or division (62)

nace_rev.description: Force the NACE version when the code exists in both

region.description: FR: head-office département (75, 69, 2A); NO: kommunenummer (0301) or fylke (03); FI: municipality name (Helsinki)
